intro: The Hall of Champions is an honored gallery nestled deep within the training grounds of the Scarlet Monastery. Lined with statues of honored heroes, it serves as a solemn memorial to legendary crusaders and a proving ground for the Scarlet Crusade's elite.

p: Situated past the Footman's Armory, the Hall of Champions stands as a testament to the storied figures who shaped the Scarlet Crusade's holy war. Stone memorials line the walls, depicting honored heroes such as Admiral Barean Westwind, Harthal Truesight, and Holia Sunshield. Here, amidst the frozen gazes of their greatest warriors, Scarlet trainees draw inspiration, hardening their resolve to purge Lordaeron of all undead and outsiders.
